description: UCL Student Union What's On listing ('Create event', /product/add/event): a club or society event on the What's On calendar (Drupal Commerce product bundle 'event'). The SU's own steps: sign in, open What's On, click 'Create event' (which opens /product/add/event), fill in the event details, pick the owning group (club or society), prefer an existing venue over creating a duplicate, and leave the optional sections ('Access to event and sales') blank if they don't apply. Promote only once every required form (ARF, risk assessment, TRF) is approved. Free tickets are created by the society on the SU website itself; paid tickets go through the Ticket Request Form, which asks for this listing's URL. Never press Save, Publish or Preview from a definition.

verified: url: /product/add/event, reached from the 'Create event' button on /whats-on (confirmed from signed-in capture, 2026-10-24)
an anonymous /whats-on has no Create event link, and /product/add/event requires sign-in (checked 2026-10-23)

selectors confirmed from signed-in capture of /product/add/event (samples/su/forms/su_event_listing, captured 2026-10-24): commerce-product-event-add-form, field_event_owner_group is a <select> of the officer's societies, field_access_wheelchair is Yes/No radios, field_access_family is a <select> (No/Yes/Partial), banner and card image uploads, variations inline entity form
_todo.unverified: Body textarea is backed by CKEditor 5 on the live page; not yet end-to-end filled on the live SU form.
